source_hypotheses.required: Specific principally polarized QM surface with maximal order and positive involution, not any principal polarization on a QM surface.

source_hypotheses.justification: Equation(3)/Lemma3 match μ inverse convention; lower-left entry (2−√2)√3 is positive; retained unimodular matrix and maximal-order identification are explicit predecessors.

constructed_objects.required: The actual polarized surface in Q6 and normalized quotient X0^6(1)/W6.
constructed_objects.constructed: Same universal fiber A of the full-three model, with canonical principal polarization; forget-level/order map to polarized moduli.
constructed_objects.justification: Existing A001/Baba–Granath argument identifies moduli datum before coordinates; equation(2) expressly maps that quotient to Q6. No discriminant210 replacement.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every allowed rational six-contact input; source exceptions and components respected.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: u rational outside six contacts; j=−57600F(u)^2/G(u)^6 finite and nonzero; same Q6 component.
index_domain_coverage.justification: F(u) is nonzero and discriminant(G)<0. Hence J10 and ψ4 are nonzero. CM points on the allowed locus are included. No Euler-system index or inverse-limit domain occurs.

transition_maps.required: The moduli/weighted-coordinate map must be for the same polarization and normalized Hauptmodul.
transition_maps.constructed: j takes 0,infinity,−16/27 at CM discriminants−4,−3,−24; Igusa tuple is source equation(2).
transition_maps.justification: Eq(14) gives ψ4=144j, χ10=−j^3/4. Their equal-weight ratio gives j=16·144^5χ10²/ψ4^5; then separately cited theta conventions are consumed.

limiting_object_identity.required: No limit here; identify the function and actual surface consumed downstream.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: The same A and j as the universal fiber/moduli point; actual six-contact theta-height transfer.
limiting_object_identity.justification: Identity is a function equality on the specified Q6 image, not agreement of equations for unrelated curves. The literal318 consumes a different five-contact geometric object.

coefficient_conventions.required: Trace form with μ inverse; weighted-projective Igusa and modular weights; edition-specific numbering.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: V13 uses Trd(μ^-1 x conjugate(y)), weights1,2,3,5 and same representative; ratio has equal total weight.
coefficient_conventions.justification: Checked v1 equations2,3,14 and Lemma3. Publisher public AppendixB confirms discriminant6 row but calls s_k definitions equation14, whereas v1 calls them15. Full final-version transfer remains open.

exceptional_cases.constructed: Specified Q6 point excludes j=0,infinity; same canonical polarization; preprint version explicitly cited.
exceptional_cases.justification: General stable subgroup Wμ is not automatically full W_D. Source main publication body not obtained; no assertion of final-number equivalence or hidden discr210 table import.
